title: Degreewise epimorphism of the restricted sections factorization
statement: For any scheme X, bounded-below complex K, presentation T, integers q,n, the degree-n factorization of the restricted sections inclusion through T.L.step q is epic.

proof.text: The retained total in degree n is the finite coproduct of exactly the diagonal summands with second index at least q. The finite-diagonal sections comparison identifies this coproduct with the image defining the second-filtration step, so the induced map onto that step is epic.

proof_origin.place: Tag 015J, proof remark (3), finite diagonal comparison
